digest.component_or_area: Cloud/DC atomic executor integration behind legacy-default seam
propositions: Constructor-injected legacy-default selector must route only exact summary mutations when test-enabled, leaving mixed-field mutations on single legacy call with no config or environment key

Success dispositions (applied, recovered, already_satisfied) must map to legacy result surface, derive synced_fields from routed mutation's fields["summary"], and advance ADR-0026 baseline identically

Terminal dispositions (commit_unknown, retryable_deferred, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, and all non-success outcomes) must emit single redacted per-mutation error message capped at 512 Unicode code points without advancing baseline or persisting deferral
Generic _call_with_retry must be poisoned on selected exact-summary route while all unselected routes are preserved
retry_not_before from OperationOutcome must be carried to manifest for observability only, not persisted as deferral in S1
